name: memrain
description: Connect Claude Code to your Memrain memory over MCP: search, read and write pages, facts and timelines shared across sessions, plus a small set of skills for working with it.

mcp_url.title: Memrain MCP URL
mcp_url.description: Your server's /mcp endpoint, for example https://brain.example.com/mcp. The local quickstart serves http://127.0.0.1:18790/mcp.

token.title: Memrain token
token.description: A personal access token from `memrain auth create`, or the token `make local-up` printed.
